basic_profile.summary: I build and run backend systems for SaaS at scale. At Whydonate, a European fundraising platform, I'm the backend engineer, responsible for infrastructure that handles 4M+ API requests/day and processes significant monthly payment volume.The problems I spend my time on: API performance (cut response times 70% on a system serving 60k+ users), payment infrastructure (Stripe, Razorpay, webhooks, failed-payment recovery), and scaling data systems (PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, AWS, Cloudflare Workers). Lately, a lot of production RAG and LLM API work too
